authority: H68 human decision: owning lanes prove additive full-certificate PassCorrect bridges; G49 adapters stay pending until they land.
genericRequirements: For each family i the owner must first publish the concrete canonical endpoint API, then prove the corresponding factory type below:

- `NativeContext_i`: the family's actual typed program/producer indices. - `Approved_i`: its UNCHANGED independently approved/admitted producer domain, with a proof of that domain's agreement/coverage. It must not be a success-only or implemented-fragment filter or an extra per-pass no-failure condition. - `A_i, B_i : NativeContext_i → Lang Event Outcome` with the original resource orders, Allowed/Admissible/Forward/Guard predicates and consistent prefixes. - `ps_i : (x : NativeContext_i) → (A_i x).Prog` and the analogous `pt_i`. - `beta_i : (x : NativeContext_i) → (B_i x).Env → (A_i x).Env`, prescribed independently of pc and proved uniform with the single public map across programs/artifacts in the fixed interface context. - `nu_i : (x : NativeContext_i) → (B_i x).Env → (A_i x).Res → (B_i x).Res`, an independently prescribed executable bound, not a choice witness or a post-hoc name for pc.need. - `Local_i`: the ENTIRE exact original conditional lane conclusion, keeping its old quantifiers/antecedents and all physical/frame/state/step facts.

The names with family suffixes are REQUIRED OWNER DELIVERABLES, not asserted existing APIs. The inspected local statements do not already publish all their canonical Lang/program/map/bound definitions. Owners must include operational and source-origin/encoding/observation binding equations to the actual executions. Arbitrary Behaviours, empty/trivial traces, success-only prefix families and narrowed resource/environment domains are not acceptable instantiations. `typedRunPrefixes` is not already a G01 Event/Outcome language: its actual Unit/raw typed-state observations and missing transaction/general-call semantics still require proof.

A factory quantifies the full approved native context. Original local preconditions such as Entry, Input or a selected successful phase remain in Local_i's original implications; they cannot silently become new restrictions on the full bridge. Owners must establish their actual reached applicability and independently prove the other outcomes/prefixes. Returning an assumed full certificate or BridgeGoal as a premise merely moves the obligation and does not fulfill this request. Reuse the original local theorems; do not restate, weaken or edit them.

The pc component must supply ALL existing PassCorrect fields: the fixed beta is sound and onto for the full Allowed environments; nu transports each source A/F/G bound to target A/F/G with Prefix.Le; and every target A/G prefix maps back to source A/G with reverse Prefix.Le, without adding backward Forward. No monotonicity of nu is requested. Complete events/outcomes and hash guards remain those of the actual canonical languages.
commonResultType:
open Solidity.Roadmap Solidity.Roadmap.G49Final

abbrev BridgeGoal (A B : Lang Event Outcome)
    (ps : A.Prog) (pt : B.Prog)
    (beta : B.Env → A.Env)
    (nu : B.Env → A.Res → B.Res)
    (Local : Prop) :=
  { pc : PassCorrect (Behaviour.ofLang A ps) (Behaviour.ofLang B pt) //
      pc.envAbs = beta ∧ pc.need = nu ∧ Local }
